```lean
theorem lg_target {n a : ℕ} : (∃ x, x ^ n = a) ↔ n = 0 ∧ a = 1 ∨ n ≠ 0 ∧ n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := by
  split
  · intro h
    cases h with x hx
    constructor
    · exact (nat.one_pow n).symm
    · exact hx
  · intro h
    cases h with h0 h1
    · constructor
      · exact h0
      · exact (nat.one_pow n).symm
    · constructor
      · exact h1.1
      · rw [nat.nth_root_def]
        exact h1.2
```
